sourceDataset: Eye on Methane / MARS detected sources and plumes
datasetAttribution: Contains data from UNEP IMEO Eye on Methane / MARS, licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Changes: normalized the source and plume CSV tables into JSON; source feedback remains source-level; unresolved plume links are retained; no mitigation confirmation is inferred.

sourceProvenance.dataset: Eye on Methane / MARS detected sources and plumes
sourceProvenance.attribution: Contains data from UNEP IMEO Eye on Methane / MARS, licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Changes: normalized the source and plume CSV tables into JSON; source feedback remains source-level; unresolved plume links are retained; no mitigation confirmation is inferred.

method: Distinct dated detections and observed median flux only; source status remains contextual. No non-detections, repairs, or future outcomes are inferred.
limitations: Priority is an uncalibrated investigation aid, not a physical leak likelihood or future-flux forecast.
Observation coverage varies by sensor, revisit schedule, geography, and cloud conditions; missing observations do not mean zero emissions.
Source notification and feedback metadata do not verify recipient, repair, or emissions reduction.
This small curated casebook has not been independently validated as a predictive model.
